prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
A good starting point is **Shere’s Construction & Handyman** for a mix of remodeling and repair work. Its BBB profile lists an **A+ rating and accreditation**, and describes kitchen and bathroom updates, additions, drywall, painting, flooring, decks, and general repairs. Call **(417) 385-8899**. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/profile/general-contractor/sheres-construction-handyman-0734-1000009996)

For a larger renovation, **GRC General Construction** is another option: its BBB profile lists an **A+ rating and accreditation** and services including kitchen and bathroom renovations, flooring, and custom carpentry. Call **(417) 499-7424**. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/profile/remodel-contractors/grc-general-construction-0734-1000049263)

BBB ratings are one signal, not a guarantee. Before hiring, get at least three written bids, ask for recent local references and proof of insurance, and make sure the contract spells out scope, payment schedule, permits, and change orders.
